action: Browser: find how a seed VC fund accepts pitches on its website

outcomes.outcome: Only a general contact page or LinkedIn

sources: Spot check of 15 well-known US seed fund websites, 2026-10-11: forms 3, pitch emails 3, general contact or LinkedIn only 9 (JavaScript not rendered, so forms are undercounted)

Gompers, Gornall, Kaplan and Strebulaev, How Do Venture Capitalists Make Decisions?, NBER 2016: about 10% of deals come from cold inbound, https://www.nber.org/digest/dec16/how-do-venture-capitalists-make-decisions

typical_time: seconds; bounces and auto-replies within minutes
sources: Validity 2025 Email Benchmark Report: 1.5% bounce rate, about 84% inbox placement, https://validity.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/2025-Benchmark-Report-FINAL.pdf
ZoomInfo 2023 via CMSWire: median 2.7% out-of-office replies, https://www.cmswire.com/the-wire/zoominfo-data-reveals-best-and-worst-times-of-year-to-send-email/

action: Cold pitch to an investor (no mutual introduction): investor response
applies_when: within about two weeks of the pitch
sources: Gornall and Strebulaev field experiment, 80,000 pitch emails to 28,000 investors (2018): 6.5% any reply, 4.3% interested, https://www.gsb.stanford.edu/insights/do-vcs-really-favor-white-male-founders

action: Warm introduction to an investor: investor response
sources: Jason Yeh 2024 fundraising conversion funnel: intro to meeting about 70% (practitioner heuristic), https://adamant.beehiiv.com/p/fundraising-conversion-funnel
Gompers et al. NBER 2016: about 90% of closed deals arrived through networks or referrals

action: Schedule a first meeting after an investor says yes
sources: Zeeg 2025-26, 1M meetings: 6.6% rescheduled, 12.2% cancelled (vendor data), https://zeeg.me/en/data/cancellations-and-reschedules
meetergo 2026, 841k meetings: booking lead time distribution (vendor data), https://meetergo.com/en/data/booking-lead-time
Gompers et al. NBER 2016 survey of 885 VCs, per closed deal: 34 met, 11 partner reviews, 4.6 due diligence, 1.5 term sheets, 1 close, https://www.nber.org/papers/w22587

action: Partner meeting at a fund that can lead the round
sources: Gompers et al. NBER 2016: 11 partner reviews to 4.6 due diligence per closed deal, https://www.nber.org/papers/w22587

action: Due diligence by a lead-capable fund

outcomes.outcome: Term sheet (lead about 60% of the round)

sources: Gompers et al. NBER 2016: 4.6 due diligence to 1.5 term sheets per closed deal, https://www.nber.org/papers/w22587
Carta 2025: seed leads take about 61% of the round, https://carta.com/data/linkedin-lead-investor-taking-60-percent-allocation/
Gompers et al. NBER 2016: 1.5 term sheets to 1 close, https://www.nber.org/papers/w22587

DocSend December 2024: most successful seeds closed within 12 weeks, https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/vcs-prioritize-people-in-an-ai-heavy-landscape-according-to-new-dropbox-docsend-report-302334444.html

action: Follower or angel meeting after a lead has committed
applies_when: a lead investor has already committed
sources: DocSend December 2023: successful seeds contacted about 66 investors and took 38 meetings (weak inference to per-meeting follower conversion), https://www.stocktitan.net/news/DBX/why-now-successful-founders-display-urgency-among-market-competition-ppgbwiwalzdk.html

action: SAFE sent for e-signature to a committed investor
sources: DocuSign FY2025 annual report: 76% of agreements complete within 24 hours, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1261333/000126133325000045/docu_annualreportfy25-foru.pdf
Carta State of Pre-Seed 2025: post-money SAFE is the standard instrument, https://carta.com/data/state-of-pre-seed-2025/

typical_time: angels 1-3 days; funds 1-2 weeks (capital calls about 10 business days)
sources: FRB Services: Fedwire settles in real time, https://app.frbservices.org/financial-services/wires/index.html
Amplify Partners SAFE financing overview: 1-2 weeks term sheet to wire, https://amplifypartners.com/blog-posts/safe-financing-overview-timelines-process-docs
Reed Smith on the ILPA model LPA: 10 business day capital call notice, https://www.reedsmith.com/en/perspectives/2019/12/comment-fund-finance-and-the-model-lpa
